description: Manage a package with the system package manager

name.description: Default package name or winget ID

namesByDistribution.description: Package names by Linux os-release ID, then ID_LIKE in order

namesByManager.description: Package names by backend when no distribution name matches

managedBy.description: Where the installed package comes from: with Nix the NixOS configuration, the Home Manager configuration or a nix profile (the user's or the shared one); other: installed outside furnish (see command)

declaredIn.description: Nix only: the folder of the NixOS or Home Manager configuration that declares the package, if furnish knows it

_exist.description: Whether the package should be installed

_metadata.description: What-if details: the steps a set would perform

packageManager.description: Use this package manager (default: the first one found)

nixpkgs.description: Flake reference to install Nix packages from (default: the registry's nixpkgs, which NixOS pins to the system's)

command.description: A program the package provides, e.g. claude. If the package manager doesn't have the package but the program is there (installed with npm or the vendor's installer, say), the package counts as installed outside furnish: furnish neither installs it again nor updates or removes it

path.description: Where the program was found, when the package was installed outside furnish (managedBy: other)

reportVersions.description: Set by furnish for required versions: also report versionScheme, via, latestVersion and, with all, availableVersions

targetVersion.description: Set by furnish for required versions: install or update to exactly this version

latestVersion.description: With reportVersions: the newest version on offer, installed or not (for an installer: the version in the file), if known

availableVersions.description: With reportVersions all: every version that can be installed
